name: Arugula, Apricot & Chickpea Salad with Feta, Couscous & Pistachios

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with cumin, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and, stirring halfway through, roast until crispy, 15-20 minutes.
In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
708 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl.
Medium dice apricots and add to bowl with arugula. Shell pistachios and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 dried apricots
¾ cup pistachios, unsalted
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Grate 3 tsp of lemon zest. Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together zest, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, honey, cumin, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
zest and juice of 1 ½ lemon
3 cloves garlic
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp honey
¾ tsp cumin
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Uncover couscous and fluff with a fork. Add couscous and chickpeas to bowl and toss salad until well combined.
To serve, place salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
